title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre Tucker catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Tre Tucker caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Tucker struggled in a tough matchup and with Fernando Mendoza making his first career start. It is unclear what his role will be moving forward with Mendoza now starting the rest of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. shut down Sunday
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. ran for 23 yards on eight carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught his lone target for four yards receiving.
items.impact: Washington saw eight carries to Ashton Jeanty's nine carries on a day where they were both once again shut down on the ground. He remains a volatile flex play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Jeanty totals 64 yards from scrimmage Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty ran for 18 yards on nine carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 46 yards receiving.
items.impact: Jeanty was once again shut down on the ground. The majority of his yardage on the day came on a catch and run for 38 yards. He remains a borderline RB2 play for fantasy managers right now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fernando Mendoza runs for touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Fernando Mendoza completed 17-of-29 passes for 143 yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Mendoza had some success early in his first career start, including a rushing touchdown on his first possession. He lost Brock Bowers to an injury early which didn't help. Mendoza did not turn the ball over, but he was sacked six times. He draws another tough matchup next week against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Seahawks D/ST dominates in second half Sunday
items.desc: The Seahawks defense allowed 13 points on 163 total yards with six sacks on Sunday.
items.impact: Fernando Mendoza had some success early in his first career start, but the Seahawks locked in against him by the second half. They will be facing the 49ers in Week 12 out of their bye.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Myers misses field goal Sunday
items.desc: Jason Myers went 0-for-1 on field goal attempts and 3-for-3 on extra point attempts.
items.impact: Myers missed a field goal from 44 yards out. He is still 16-of-18 on the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Barner hauls in three passes Sunday
items.desc: AJ Barner caught 3-of-3 targets for 19 yards in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Barner remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton not targeted Sunday
items.desc: Tory Horton was not targeted in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: While he was not targeted, Horton had an impressive play on special teams as he batted a kickoff in bounds to help take the clock under the two minute warning. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashid Shaheed catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed caught 1-of-2 targets for eight yards in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Shaheed was making his way back from injured reserve. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Kupp hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp hauled in his lone target for a 34-yard touchdown in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Kupp got open in the end zone with Drew Lock stopping just in front of the line scrimmage and finding him for a sliding catch. Kupp remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba explodes in third quarter Sunday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 8-of-10 targsts for 171 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba entered halftime with just 11 yards before exploding for a huge third quarter that included a 71-yard touchdown reception plus other gains of 30 and 23 yards. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Jadarian Price ran for 36 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders. He also caught his lone target for eight yards receiving.
items.impact: Price was able to score a touchdown for the first time in his career. He continues to look like the 1B in the backfield for Seattle with Zach Charbonnet as the 1A. Price remains a steady flex option.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Charbonnet runs for 94 yards Sunday
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet ran for 94 yards on 20 carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Despite it just being a few games for Charbonnet since returning from his torn ACL, he continues to impress on the ground. He remains a solid RB2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drew Lock tosses two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Drew Lock completed 14-of-17 passes for 240 yards with two touchdowns in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Lock continues to win as a starter for the Seahawks. His two touchdowns came on improvised deep passes to Cooper Kupp and Jaxon Smith-Njigba. The Seahawks now head into their bye week with the quarterback situation unclear heading into Week 12.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cardinals D/ST struggles Sunday
items.desc: The Cardinals defense allowed 34 points on 436 total yards with one interception and two sacks.
items.impact: Matthew Stafford still tossed three touchdowns despite playing with a depleted wide receiver room. The Cardinals defense remains well off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chad Ryland makes two field goals Sunday
items.desc: Chad Ryland was 2-for-2 on field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Ryland connected on two field goals from 49 yards out in the opening quarter. That would be all the scoring on the day for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey McBride catches five passes Sunday
items.desc: Trey McBride caught 5-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
items.impact: McBride was a safety blanket for Carson Beck in his NFL debut as a starter. He remains a steady high-end TE1 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Simi Fehoko hauls in one pass Sunday
items.desc: Simi Fehoko caught 1-of-2 targets for 21 yards in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
items.impact: Fehoko hauled in one big play from Carson Beck. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devin Duvernay totals 35 yards Sunday
items.desc: Devin Duvernay caught 2-of-3 targets for 35 yards in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
items.impact: The lone mistake by Duvernay was a dropped pass that led to an interception for Carson Beck. The duo also connected on a 31-yard pass. Duvernay remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bam Knight runs for 19 yards Sunday
items.desc: Bam Knight ran for 19 yards on five carries in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
items.impact: Making his return from the concussion protocol, Knight and Tyler Allgeier both saw five carries in the blowout loss. They will be tougher to trust in lineups splitting the work on what is currently a not very good offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Allgeier quiet Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier ran for 14 yards on five carries in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
items.impact: The Cardinals backfield returned to a committee with Bam Knight healthy. They'll both be tougher to trust in lineups splitting snaps on what is currently a bad offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Beck struggles in first start Sunday
items.desc: Carson Beck completed 11-of-18 passes for 108 yards and two interceptions in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
items.impact: Beck had some nice moments early, including a 31-yard pass to Devin Duvernay. His first interception also came on a dropped pass by Duvernay. He will be a borderline QB2 play next week against the Chiefs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rams D/ST totals five sacks Sunday
items.desc: The Rams defense allowed six points on 123 total yards with two interceptions and five sacks on Sunday against the Cardinals.
items.impact: The Rams defense made it tough on Carson Beck in his first career start. They'll face the Packers in two weeks out of their bye.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon McManus connects on all six kicks Sunday
items.desc: Brandon McManus was 2-for-2 on field goals and 4-of-4 on extra point attempts.
items.impact: McManus connected on field goals from 24 and 43 yards out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Davis Allen finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Davis Allen caught his lone target for a 19-yard touchdown in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Allen took full advantage of his lone target on the afternoon. He remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson caught 2-of-2 targets for 11 yards in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Parkinson remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Higbee catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Higbee caught 3-of-4 targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Higbee could have had two touchdowns, but Matthew Stafford overthrew him on one. He'll remain a touchdown dependent streamer for fantasy managers out of the bye week for the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Smith catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Smith caught 2-of-2 targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Smith turned a screen pass from Matthew Stafford into a 22-yard score for the Rams.  He still remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tutu Atwell hauls in one pass Sunday
items.desc: Tutu Atwell caught 1-of-2 targets for 31 yards in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Atwell had one big gain of 31 yards from Matthew Stafford on the day. He remains a big play dependent WR4 for fantasy managers despite the Rams wide receiver room being banged up.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Konata Mumpfield totals 81 yards Sunday
items.desc: Konata Mumpfield caught 3-of-4 targets for 81 yards in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: With the Rams wide receiver room depleted, it was Mumpfield who led the way for them. He had two big gains of 45 and 27 yards. He'll hold WR3/flex upside out of the Rams bye week if Davante Adams remains sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Corum runs for 100 yards Sunday
items.desc: Blake Corum ran for 100 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 3-of-4 targets for 19 yards receiving.
items.impact: Kyren Williams got the start for the Rams per usual, but Corum wound up being the hot hand on the day in the Rams backfield. He also added three receptions on the day. He remains a steady RB2 for fantasy managers, especially with the Rams wide receiver room banged up.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyren Williams quiet Sunday
items.desc: Kyren Williams ran for 23 yards on 12 carries in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 2-of-5 targets for nine yards receiving.
items.impact: Williams started the game for the Rams per usual, but Blake Corum wound up being the hot hand on the day. He did have a receiving touchdown called back. Despite a down performance this week, Williams remains a steady RB2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew Stafford tosses three touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Matthew Stafford completed 18-of-26 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Despite being without Puka Nacua (to go along with Davante Adams still being sidelined), Stafford still managed to make it work in a blowout win for the Rams. He tossed touchdowns to Xavier Smith, Davis Allen and Tyler Higbee. The Rams will look to get healthier heading into their bye next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jacksonville Jaguars take care of business against Titans
items.desc: The Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST picked off Titans' QB Cam Ward once on Sunday to go along with a sack in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans.
items.impact: The Jaguars' defense took care of business in this game, though the Titans did their best to hang around for a while. They are looking like a great unit right now and could be a tough out in the playoffs to come.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cam Little puts up 16 kicking points in Week 10
items.desc: Cam Little hit all four of his PATs and all four of his field goal attempts in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
items.impact: Little was perfect in this game, hitting all eight of his PATs and field goal kicks. He now has 31 kicking points in his last two games and looks like a premier kicker in fantasy.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Travis Hunter catches two passes in Week 10 win
items.desc: Travis Hunter caught both of his targets for 16 yards in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans. On defense, he racked up five total tackles, including three solo tackles, a pass defended, and an interception.
items.impact: While he was once again limited on offense, on defense, he was great in the secondary. He managed to pick off Titans QB Cam Ward, as well as rack up a handful of tackles. He's not a great asset in regular skill-position leagues, but in IDP style, his dual-threat combo is amazing.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Josh Cameron breaks out for touchdown in win over Titans
items.desc: Josh Cameron caught all three of his targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
items.impact: Cameron had not had more than a single catch in three straight games, but exploded for a long touchdown reception in this contest. He's someone to keep an eye on for the future and in dynasty, but isn't relevant for redraft purposes.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. snags three passes in win over Titans
items.desc: Brian Thomas Jr. caught three of four targets for 29 yards in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
items.impact: Thomas was in a four way tie for second most on the Jaguars in receptions, and was fourth on the team in yards. If you haven't already, go ahead and drop him. He is not rosterable unless there is an injury ahead of him, and even then, the Jaguars could decide to promote Travis Hunter to WR instead.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Brenton Strange snags touchdown in win
items.desc: Brenton Strange caught two of three targets for nine yards and a score in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
items.impact: Strange's fantasy day was saved by the touchdown. He went through a nice four-week stretch earlier this season, but in his last two weeks, he has just 31 yards and a score. It's a rough patch for the Jags TE1, but with the offense humming as it is, his weeks will come once again.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jakobi Meyers goes for 34 yards in win
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers caught three of six targets for 34 yards in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
items.impact: Meyers was third on the team in yards and in a four way tie for second in receptions, but even with Trevor Lawrence throwing for 352 yards, it didn't mean much for Meyers with the ball being so spread out. He's certainly capable of usable fantasy performances, but it seems on an every-other-week sort of basis right now.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. quiet in win over Titans
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran four times for five yards in the Jaguars' dominant 40-23 win over the Titans.
items.impact: CRod was dealing with injuries heading into this week, so it's not surprising to see him get a reduced workload. What was surprising was his total lack of efficiency on those limited touches. He had a long gain of six yards, which means that his other three carries totaled for -1 yard. It's a tough break after a decent performance against the Ravens ten days ago, and he will look to have a better outing next time out against the Giants.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dak Prescott tosses five touchdowns in Week 10 loss to 49ers
items.desc: Dak Prescott completed 30-of-51 pass attempts for 343 yards, five touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing four times for seven yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 Week 10 loss to the 49ers.
items.impact: Prescott continues an impactful stretch of late, recording two or more touchdowns in each of his last four games. The dynamic signal-caller will look to take advantage of an underwhelming Tennessee Titans secondary in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: George Pickens hauls in three touchdowns in Week 10 loss to 49ers
items.desc: George Pickens hauled in 11 of his team-leading 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 Week 10 loss to the 49ers.
items.impact: Pickens has found his way to the end zone of late, scoring one or more touchdowns in three of his last five games. The wideout offers fantasy managers one of the more impactful pass-catching options ahead of a favorable Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Javonte Williams leads backfield in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Javonte Williams carried the ball 16 times for 63 yards while also catching his lone target for four yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
items.impact: Williams has been productive out of the backfield of late, rushing for over 60 yards in three of his last four contests. The running back will look to take advantage of an underperforming Tennessee Titans defense in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: CeeDee Lamb finds end zone in Week 10 loss to 49ers
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his 13 targets for 73 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-30 Week 10 loss to the 49ers.
items.impact: Lamb has caught fire on offense of late, finishing with over 70 receiving yards and at least one touchdown in three of his last four games. The pass-catcher remains one of the more dynamic WR1 options for fantasy managers ahead of a generous Week 11 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ryan Flournoy reaches end zone in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Ryan Flournoy caught six of his seven targets for 71 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
items.impact: Flournoy has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a touchdown in three of his last five contests. The wideout has been one of the more inconsistent pass-catching options in the Dallas offense ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: C.J. Stroud tosses three more touchdowns in Week 10
items.desc: C.J. Stroud completed 20-of-38 passes for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
items.impact: A week after firing five touchdown passes, Stroud followed up with three more Sunday afternoon. The Texans QB has now thrown for multiple scores in four straight weeks, recording 1a 13-3 TD/INT ratio in the process. Stroud is definitely playing at a QB1 level for fantasy purposes. The Colts present another inviting matchup in Week 11.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Parker Washington explodes against Titans
items.desc: Parker Washington caught seven of nine targets for 152 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
items.impact: This was Washington's second 100-yard game of the season and his highest yardage total overall. He was limited to just two catches against Baltimore last time out, failing to corral some targets that should have been caught. However, he made his opportunities count this time around, going nuclear against the Titans' woeful defense. He's right on the edge of WR1/WR2 territory from here on out.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Woody Marks gains 65 yards, leaves with concussion Sunday
items.desc: Woody Marks exited Sunday's game early with a concussion and did not return.
items.impact: Marks gained 50 yards on 12 carries and caught one pass for 15 yards before leaving what ended up being a 27-24 loss to the Browns. With a quick turnaround coming for a matchup against the Colts on Thursday, Marks' chances to play in Week 11 seem very slim. Emari Demercado could see plenty of work if Marks sits.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Patriots D/ST struggles in Week 10
items.desc: The Patriots D/ST allowed 35 points while notching two sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
items.impact: The Patriots struggled on defense for a second straight week as they coughed up 45 points to the Packers in Week 9. Their bye in Week 11 comes at a perfect time, with a plus matchup vs. the Chargers awaiting in Week 12.
